entries.dbd05a83bc6610a0: Based on the principle that 'stores exist for customers', it aims to improve business performance while differentiating itself from other companies in 'people, merchandise and stores'. It aims to build dominance in its trade areas by using four store formats suited to local population, and it is also expanding and remodeling existing stores. In its merchandise policy, it works to improve the markup rate and quality of its PB products, its own original products, and aims to offer its three core product lines, 'building materials, DIY and gardening products', 'household goods' and 'furniture and home fashion goods', with the best selection, price and quality in each region.

entries.f5791407b1ebadb6: As of March 31, 2026, it operates 359 stores in 34 prefectures, expanding its store network from the Kyushu and Chugoku regions into the Kansai, Chubu and Kanto regions. Its strength lies in a wide product range centered on large suburban stores with ample parking, serving customers from individual consumers to professional tradespeople. It also works to expand its PB products, its own original products.
